instruction: Position the text in the upper-right area of the canvas.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving text to upper-right area. Evaluator uses connected component analysis to identify text as a cohesive region and checks if the text bounding box center is in the upper-right quadrant (right 30%, top 30%). Verified: Corner positioning is achievable in GIMP.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses connected component analysis (gimp.py:37) to identify text as a cohesive region, not scattered pixels.
Proper text detection: Finds largest connected component (gimp.py:43-58) and filters out noise with minimum 50-pixel threshold, ensuring text-like structures are identified.
Correct bounding box logic: Calculates bounding box of text region (gimp.py:64-76) and uses center point to determine position.
Reasonable thresholds: Uses 70% right, 30% top (gimp.py:81-82) to define upper-right area, which appropriately represents upper-right quadrant.
Complete coverage: Instruction requires text to be in upper-right area, and evaluator checks exactly this requirement.
Proper state capture: Postconfig exports GIMP file to PNG (Shift+Ctrl+E), ensuring text position is saved and can be analyzed.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add validation that text string 'topright_textbox' was successfully rendered (though current logic of finding largest dark region is robust).
Minor edge case: If multiple text boxes exist, only largest is checked. Could verify no other large text regions exist outside upper-right area.
